## Commands

```sh
npm run lint
npm run check
npm run test
./scripts/verify.sh
```

## Rules

- The board is the source of truth; a chat message is not a handoff.
- A card moves to Done only with proof attached.
- Keep one owner per card.
- Update `okf/` when behavior, commands, or architecture change.
- Never commit secrets. Use environment variables and the Ask-first gates.
- Run `./scripts/verify.sh` before you report work as done.
